structure.abstract:
Abstract.In this paper, we mainly investigate the𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein projective dimension of modules and the (left)𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein global dimension of rings. Some properties of𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein projective dimensions are obtained. Furthermore, we prove that the (left)𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein global dimension of a ringRRis equal to the supremum of the set of𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein
projective dimensions of all cyclic (left)RR-modules. This result extends the well-known Auslander’s theorem on the global dimension and its Gorenstein homological version.2010 Mathematics Subject Classfication: 16D80, 16E10, 16G50Key words:𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein projective modules,𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein projective dimensions of modules,𝔛\mathfrak{X}-Gorenstein global projective dimensions of rings
